lines: Manish Sharma, Promoter Selling Shareholder, may receive up to ₹6.08 crore if all offered shares are sold (estimate, employee-portion shares sell at a discount so actual proceeds are slightly lower).
The sale money is already in hand since listing, with trading starting March 11, 2026, which makes this a timely call.
Family link: 'Priyanka Manish Sharma' contains 'Manish Sharma'. Average cost of acquisition is unknown, so the gain cannot be stated.
Retained stake is estimated at ₹110.73 crore, valued at the offer price.
